definitions.gloss: meal prep; cooking food in advance; dishes prepared ahead of time
definitions.explanation: the practice of preparing meals or side dishes in advance to save time during busy weekdays

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}に{作|つく}り{置|お}きをしておく。
examples.english: I do meal prep on the weekends.

examples.japanese: {作|つく}り{置|お}きのおかずがあると{平日|へいじつ}が{楽|らく}だ。
examples.english: Having prepared side dishes makes weekdays easier.

examples.japanese: {忙|いそが}しい{人|ひと}のための{作|つく}り{置|お}きレシピ{本|ほん}が{人気|にんき}だ。
examples.english: Meal prep recipe books for busy people are popular.

notes:
FORMS:
{作|つく}る (to make) + {置|お}く (to leave, to put aside) → to make and leave/store
{作|つく}り{置|お}きする (to do meal prep)
{作|つく}り{置|お}く (to make and store)

POPULARITY:
{作|つく}り{置|お}き has become a major trend in Japan, with many cookbooks, blogs, and TV shows dedicated to the topic. It's especially popular among:
- Working parents
- Single people living alone
- People who want to save money

COMMON {作|つく}り{置|お}き ITEMS:
- {煮物|にもの} (simmered dishes)
- マリネ (marinated vegetables)
- {酢|す}の{物|もの} (vinegared dishes)
- {常備菜|じょうびさい} (regular side dishes)

RELATED WORDS:
- {常備菜|じょうびさい} (dishes kept on hand)
- {下|した}ごしらえ (food preparation)
- {時短料理|じたんりょうり} (time-saving cooking)
